shared_elements: shallow relief carving on rough stone
horizontal band or ridge across the stone face
justification: Both show worked stone monoliths bearing shallow relief in which a ring or disc and a straight horizontal band appear, and in both the carving is sparse, low and subordinate to the block's mass. But A is a scatter of pale, largely blank quarried slabs in an open excavation with a single small geometric ring-and-rectangle element, whereas B is one dark, heavily eroded upright figure-like block with vertically stacked curvilinear motifs and banded lower body, so neither the compositional scheme nor the carving manner corresponds beyond the generic.
